thread:
Ava (Marketing Ops): Morning — we had ~24 leads drop into fallback during the 08:45 spike. Enrichment still PATCHing HS at ~9-11s so RR skipped.

Liam (Sales Ops): That's spiking our SDR SLA alerts. Are attachments the culprit?

Ava (Marketing Ops): Mostly webinar uploads + a few partner API submissions. Example: lead 12045 PATCH arrived at +10.2s.

Noah (Platform Eng): Current claim window = 4s. Two low-risk fixes: increase window to 10s OR soft-assign to a transient owner and reassign after enrichment. Soft-assign keeps notifications but suppresses outreach.

Clara (Growth): Soft-assign sounds better — keeps visibility without lost notifications. We need a flag so SDRs can filter and analytics can track.

Liam (Sales Ops): Agree. Also avoid duplicate outreach when we reassign. Can we suppress task creation while transient flag is set?

Noah (Platform Eng): Yes. Proposal config snippet:

```
TRANSIENT_ASSIGN=true
TRANSIENT_OWNER=Holding - Await Enrich
TRANSIENT_FLAG=enrich_pending
SUPPRESS_TASKS_WHILE_FLAG=true
TRANSIENT_TTL=1800
WAIT_FOR_ENRICH_MS=10000
```
Behavior: immediate transient assign, wait up to 10s for enrichment; if `company_enriched` present -> run RR, reassign, add note "Auto-finalized after enrichment (prev Holding)". Emit metrics `lead.transient_assigned`, `lead.reassigned_after_enrich`.

Ava (Marketing Ops): I'll update the HS workflow to set `enrich_pending` at intake and include the reassign note text in the PR.

leadflow-bot: deploy queued: lead-router -> staging (build #1582).

Clara (Growth): Canary plan: 600 synthetic leads, 30% large payloads. Metrics: percent_transient, reassign_rate, avg_time_to_final_owner, duplicate_notify_rate. Targets: reassign_rate >90%, duplicate_notify <3%.

Noah (Platform Eng): Timeline: staging deploy now, canary at 3:00pm PT, review 4:00pm PT, prod 9:00pm if green. I'll own rollback: disable TRANSIENT_ASSIGN, set CLAIM_WINDOW_MS back to 4000, clear transient flags via backfill if needed.

Liam (Sales Ops): I'll prep the SDR note explaining Holding behavior and include HS/SF filters. Please tag Sales leadership when we go prod.

Ava (Marketing Ops): Thanks — please paste canary dashboard links and 10 sample lead ids here after run. If anything looks off we abort. :thumbsup:
